label: ACCEPT
reason: Every DRF serializer class in the api/serializers.py files is named *Serializer (LanguageCheckSerializer in core, WeightEntrySerializer in weight, ImageSerializer in gallery), while field classes and mixins in those files are not part of the group; ruff in pyproject.toml selects only F/E/W/I with no pep8-naming, so nothing catches a misnamed serializer. With no outliers, a new serializer named e.g. after its model (which would clash with the model import) is worth flagging as off the team's naming scheme.
